title: Quaint, Private Apartment, Heart Of East Nashville
description:
Quaint, Separate & Private, upstairs apartment, located in the heart of East Nashville. 5-min Uber/Lyft ride from 5 Points, which hosts unique restaurants, shops, bars & live music venues. 10-min Uber/Lyft ride from downtown, which includes world-famous Broadway Ave. Includes private patio area, both upstairs & downstairs, with its own separate entrance up a spiral staircase to the apartment. Secure entrance with digital keypad lock, to eliminate keys. Private bedroom & bathroom w/ queen bed.

The space
***Added an air purifier to the apartment, as well as a mesh screen covering the entrance to your space, to add to your safety & comfort during your stay***

Your private, separate apartment includes mini-fridge, coffee maker, towels, wash cloths, soap, shampoo & conditioner, as well as iron, ironing board & hair dryer. Flat-screen tv with cable as well. Closet to hang clothes & put suitcases is available.

Guest access
We share a driveway with neighbors, so please stay on the right side of the driveway when facing the house & park closest to the sidewalk & street, directly up against the 2 neon orange cones, thanks so much!

During your stay
I will message check-in/checkout/parking instructions the morning of your arrival & I'll be in open communication during your stay. You'll get my cell number to text/call me if you have any questions or issues with arrival, departure or suggestions while you're visiting Nashville.

Other things to note
***Added an air purifier to the apartment, as well as a mesh screen covering the entrance to your space, to add to your safety & comfort during your stay***

Please text with any questions you may have while staying with us, thank you.

We also have 4 dogs, but they do not have any access to your private apartment.
